title: Rename site/brand to 'FutureEdge Investment'

requirements.text: Rename the site/brand name from 'Planinvestgrow' to 'FutureEdge Investment' across the entire application. Update all occurrences in: the HTML page title in frontend/index.html (e.g., 'FutureEdge Investment - Mutual Fund Advisor'), the Navigation logo/brand name text in Navigation.tsx, the Footer branding in Footer.tsx, and any other component or file where 'Planinvestgrow' appears as a brand or site name. The tagline 'Plan-Invest-Grow' should remain unchanged wherever it is displayed.

quotes: Change the name to FutureEdge Investment

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html page title displays 'FutureEdge Investment - Mutual Fund Advisor' (or equivalent).
Navigation logo/brand name text reads 'FutureEdge Investment'.
No instance of 'Planinvestgrow' remains visible in the UI as a brand or site name.
The tagline 'Plan-Invest-Grow' continues to appear in all locations where it was previously displayed.

constraints: Do not change the tagline 'Plan-Invest-Grow' — only the brand/site name should change.
Do not alter any contact details, advisor credentials, color theme, or other existing content.
Immutable frontend paths (hooks, main.tsx, ui components) must not be modified.
nonGoals: Changing advisor credentials, stats, or contact information.
Updating the color theme or layout.
Modifying backend logic or data models.
